# E² Core Framework

> Public navigation index for the E² Core Framework. ORMD is the AI-facing authority; Semantic Substrate Markdown is the human reading surface.

Canonical AI mirror: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/llms.txt
HTML AI mirror: https://danpace725.github.io/e2-core-framework/
Whole-corpus HTML mirror: https://danpace725.github.io/e2-core-framework/corpus.html
Source repository: https://github.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework

## How to read this corpus

1. Start with the Context Layer Master Index.
2. Select the relevant A–I cluster and read only the ORMD documents needed for the task.
3. Preserve each document's frame, confidence, lineage, and policy metadata.
4. Do not treat the index, generated catalog, or human Markdown as a substitute for the paired ORMD authority.

- [Context Layer Master Index (ORMD)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd/context-layer-master-index.ormd)
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/catalog.json)
- [Machine-readable relationship graph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/graph.json)
- [Combined ORMD corpus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd-corpus.txt)
- [Human mobile reader](https://e2-core-framework.capulusirl.chatgpt.site/)

## Cluster A — Foundational Axioms & Core Ontology

Scope: The irreducible bedrock of E². Establishes what relationships *are*, how they compose, and what constraints govern all relational systems. Every other cluster presupposes this one.

Entry point: Relational Primitives → E^2 Equation → Global Closure Operator

## Cluster B — Formal, Mathematical & Epistemic Constraints

Scope: Formal mappings of E² into established mathematical formalisms, together with the epistemic conditions and limits governing what the framework may defensibly claim. Covers category theory, lambda calculus, relational physics, computability, embedded universality, and predictive lawfulness.

Entry point: CT Translation of RPs → RP Lambda Calc Translation → Meta-Pattern Decidability Conjecture → Embedded Universality Principle

## Cluster E — Ethics, Stewardship, Accountability & Rights

Scope: The normative and answerability layer of E². Grounds rights, stewardship, trust, custody, accountability, consequence routing, and repair in relational structure. Localization and typed-condition work make assignment inspectable within complex causal chains. Includes temporal ethics and AI interaction ethics.

## Cluster G — Consciousness, Cognition & Identity

Scope: How relational dynamics give rise to consciousness, cognitive structure, selfhood, and identity. Treats consciousness as triadic relational architecture, the self as a six-primitive coherence field, intelligence as field navigation, and cognition as collective substrate. Distinct from [F](#cluster-f "symmetric:constrains") (which addresses threats to cognitive integrity) and from [H](#cluster-h "dynamical:produces") (which applies these to social systems).

Entry point: Relational Emergence Meta-Architecture (REMA) → Collective Cognitive Substrate → Relational Volition

- [Collective Cognitive Substrate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd/collective-cognitive-substrate.ormd) — frame: cognitive.ecology.synthesis; confidence: 0.9

- [Relational Volition: A Synthesis on the Nature of Freedom within Relational Fields](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd/relational-volition.ormd) — frame: philosophy.relational-physics; confidence: 0.9

## Cluster I — Protocol, Infrastructure & Meta

Scope: The operational layer — how the Context Layer itself is structured, transmitted, and versioned. CLP defines the data model governing all other clusters; RPE is the simulation engine for relational primitives; Implementations is the living registry of E² applications.

Entry point: Context Layer Protocol (CLP) → Implementations → Relational Primitive Engine (RPE)

- [Context Layer Protocol (CLP) — Overview & Starter Spec v0.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd/context-layer-protocol-clp.ormd) — frame: protocol.specification; confidence: 0.9
- [Implementations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd/implementations.ormd) — frame: registry.implementations; confidence: 1
- [Relational Primitive Engine (RPE)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DanPace725/e2-core-framework/main/reader-site/public/ormd/relational-primitive-engine-rpe.ormd) — frame: engineering.simulation.rpe; confidence: 0.98
